theme: Light theme primary (Warm Ivory) with Dark mode sections (Deep Blue)

headings.usage: H1, H2, H3, Editorial quotes, manifesto chapters

body.usage: Body text, UI elements, navigation, buttons, small labels

typography.instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure tight tracking on large Cormorant Garamond headings. Manrope must be used for highly legible UI elements. No generic fonts like Inter for headings. Include @import url for Google Fonts in index.css.

colors.primary_description: ITACAN Deep Blue - Used for dark sections, footer, nightlife areas.
colors.accent_description: Ocean Accent - Used sparingly for hover states, accents, wave graphic.
colors.text_dark_description: Ink - Primary text color on light backgrounds.
colors.text_light_description: White - Primary text color on deep blue backgrounds.

visual_enhancers.signature_asset: Double-wave graphic. Use consistently as a divider/accent. E.g. as an SVG line separating sections (using Ocean Accent).
visual_enhancers.border_radius: rounded-none or max rounded-sm. Premium restaurants use sharp or very subtly rounded edges.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Rely on 1px subtle borders (border-neutral-secondary) or high-contrast edge definitions.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used only for the sticky header if overlapping hero image. backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 (light mode) or bg-[#074269]/80 (dark sections).
visual_enhancers.noise_texture: Add a very subtle grain overlay (opacity 2-3%) across the entire site to prevent digital flatness and add warmth.

layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use py-24 or py-32 for section vertical padding. gap-12 or gap-16 between grid items.
layouts.grid: Bento or Swiss Grid style for menu previews. Asymmetrical text and image pairings. Mode A: Tetris Grid.
layouts.hero: Large kinetic hero, masked line-by-line reveal on load. Use a striking background image with bg-[#111820]/30 overlay so the image breathes.
layouts.footer: Massive py-20, Deep Blue background (#074269), large text for 'Let's Talk / Tisch reservieren', Ocean Accent links.

motion.scrolling: Lenis smooth scrolling MUST be installed and configured in App.js or main layout.
motion.reveals: Framer Motion scroll reveals (staggered fade-up, line-by-line text reveals).
motion.marquee: One slow editorial marquee using react-fast-marquee. e.g. for repeating 'EAT. DRINK. STAY. DANCE.' with serif font.
motion.parallax: One subtle parallax hero moment or image reveal on scroll.
motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on menu items and buttons (e.g. slight transform, color fade).
motion.instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT apply universal transitions like 'transition: all'. Use specific transitions. Add aria-hidden='true' to purely decorative animations.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure WCAG AA contrast, especially for Ink text on Sand/Ivory, and White text on Deep Blue.
accessibility.test_ids: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs).

dining_vibe.description: Chic setup with crystal glassware and elegant decor

media.instructions_to_main_agent: Use ONLY these image URLs. Never use generic placeholder services. Treat photography deliberately (spotlight layouts, clipped frames).

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for the sticky header; use backdrop-blur + semi-transparent color (glassmorphism).
Do NOT apply universal transitions (e.g. transition: all). Target specific properties.
Do NOT center align the entire App container.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical. Use py-24 or py-32 for sections.
NEVER use placeholder services (via.placeholder.com). Use the provided image URLs.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid.
Provide exact installation commands for external libraries: npm install framer-motion lucide-react react-fast-marquee @studio-freight/lenis clsx tailwind-merge
Implement DE/EN language toggle logic (can be simple state or placeholder context for MVP).
